name: transcription factor binding to IGHM enhancer 3
pathways: regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II

function.text: TFE3 encodes transcription factor E3. Annotated molecular activities include DNA-binding transcription factor activity and DNA-binding transcription activator activity, RNA polymerase II-specific. It participates in positive regulation of DNA-templated transcription and regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to X-linked syndromic complex neurodevelopmental disorder (x-linked). Postzygotic mosaic associations are recorded separately.

somatic.text: Reported somatic alteration contexts include PEComa, malignant; Alveolar soft part sarcoma; Epithelioid hemangioendothelioma. The alteration class and exact variant must be assessed in the disease context.

function.text: TFE3 encodes transcription factor E3. It participates in positive regulation of DNA-templated transcription and regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II.

germline.text: Pathogenic germline variants are associated with X-linked syndromic complex neurodevelopmental disorder (x-linked).

mosaic.text: Postzygotic mosaic variants are associated with intellectual developmental disorder, X-linked, syndromic, with pigmentary mosaicism and coarse facies.

somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving TFE3 have been reported in PEComa, malignant, alveolar soft part sarcoma, and epithelioid hemangioendothelioma.
